rows.assumption: dc_power_bus is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.
rows.basis: Battery energy must enter protected DC distribution through an explicit bus.
rows.evidenceRequired: Review the interface carrier, direction, capacity, safety margin and failure mode before detailed design or sourcing.

rows.assumption: thruster_power_bus is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.
rows.basis: Thrusters must receive protected power separately from avionics and payload rails.
rows.evidenceRequired: Review the interface carrier, direction, capacity, safety margin and failure mode before detailed design or sourcing.

rows.assumption: thrust_command_bus is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.

rows.assumption: navigation_sensor_bus is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.

rows.assumption: payload_data_bus is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.

rows.assumption: pressure_boundary is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.

rows.assumption: alarm_bus is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.
rows.basis: Leak, over-depth and recovery alarms must drive fail-safe mission states.

rows.assumption: pressure_boundary is named on both endpoint modules in the generated architecture.
rows.basis: Leak and over-depth protection must reference the same pressure boundary as the hull design.
rows.evidenceRequired: Review the interface carrier, direction, capacity, safety margin and failure mode before detailed design or sourcing.
